# ffxf_vm_reinstall (Resource)

Reinstalls a virtual machine with a new image. WARNING: reinstalling wipes the VM disk and replaces all its data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_vm_reinstall" "example" {
  vm_id    = 123
  image    = "debian-13"
  ssh_keys = ["SHA256:example"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Image slug to install; the existing disk is wiped.
- `vm_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the virtual machine.

### Optional

- `ssh_keys` (Set of String) Account SSH key fingerprints or IDs to install.
